module: Stateless module that manages the rally co-driver "voicepacks": voice packages (.ogg audio + metadata.json + voicepack.json) located either globally (`/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/compositors/voicepacks/<dirname>/`) or in a mission (`<missionDir>/rally/voicepacks/<dirname>/`). It provides the file paths, reading and caching of the inventory (scan), choosing a voicepack from a "pick" or from the preferences (MRU list of the most recently used, stored in the `rallyCodriverVoicepackMRU` setting), resolution of a mission's notebook, the audio candidates (variants) of a note, and building the dropdown-type user settings (key `rallyVoicepackPick`) for stages and loops.
usage:
local vp = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/voicepack')
local dirname, entry, result = vp.resolveEffectiveEntry(missionDir, {type = 'preferences'}, {missionId = missionId})
if entry then print(entry.label, vp.getEntryAudioFile(entry, 'pacenote_123.ogg')) end
notes: Ids: 'global:<dirname>' or 'mission:<missionId>:<dirname>' (makeId/parseId). Default value: 'global:ak_2026-04-16'. The MRU is a CSV list of ids, limited to 10.

A pick is a table {type = 'preferences'|'auto'|'voicepack'|'loopVoicepack', id, scope, missionId, dirname, familyKey}. Setting value: '' for preferences, the id for a voicepack, 'loop:<familyKey>' for a loop.

The info file is called voicepack.json (and not info.json, because the mission system treats any info.json as a mission). It must contain persona, language, styleLabel and notebooks (non-empty list) otherwise the voicepack is ignored. Optional fields: dialect, compositorStyle, styleDetailLevel, enableAnimalCodrivers, enableSpeedScaling (default true in global), codriverTimingOffsetSeconds (default 0 in global, 0.2 in mission), reuseAudioFrom (list of global dirnames whose audio and metadata to reuse), cornerGapMs, phraseGapMs, linkWordGapMs, pacenoteGapMs.
Folders starting with `_` are hidden from the scan. Voicepacks with enableAnimalCodrivers == false are excluded from the inventory.
The global scan is cached for the whole lifetime of the module (invalidateCache is reserved for dev/test); the mission scan is cached per missionDir|missionId pair.
By default, listInventory excludes the voicepacks for which no candidate notebook exists in the mission (requireMissionNotebook ~= false).
Resolution order by preferences: MRU (exact id match, otherwise scope + dirname, for each MRU entry in order), then fallback to the smallest styleDetailLevel and the alphabetical order of the label.
resolveDir walks the table with pairs(): the order is undefined if several voicepacks match.
resolveLoopMissionSettingEntry returns nil for a 'preferences' pick.

globalDir.desc: '/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/compositors/voicepacks/': folder of the global voicepacks (with trailing `/`).

defaultVoicepackId.desc: 'global:ak_2026-04-16': first MRU element if it is empty.

getFile.desc: Path of a file of a global voicepack.

getAudioFile.desc: Path of an audio file of a global voicepack (under audio/).

getEntryAudioFile.desc: Path of an entry's audio file: first its own folder, then those of the reuseAudioFrom voicepacks. If the file exists nowhere, returns the local path (if the audio folder exists) or the first source path.

returns.desc: Path, nil if entry or basename is missing.

getAudioCandidates.desc: Lists the audio variants of a note from metadata. Without allowedVariants, takes all the indexed variants (`<stem>.ogg` = variant 1 and `<stem>_<n>.ogg`). With allowedVariants, takes only those. Result sorted by variant then by name.

metadata.desc: Table basename -> metadata (content of metadata.json), with audioLen.

basename.desc: Base name of the note (with or without .ogg).

pathForBasename.desc: Function basename -> path; otherwise fname = basename.

returns.desc: List of {basename, fname, audioLen, metadata, variantIndex}.

getAudioCandidatesForEntry.desc: getAudioCandidates with the paths resolved by getEntryAudioFile.

getAudioCandidatesForVoicepack.desc: getAudioCandidates with the paths of a global voicepack (getAudioFile).

returns.desc: Candidate, nil if the list is empty.

getPacenoteFile.desc: Audio path of a note by its hash in a global voicepack.

getSystemPacenoteFile.desc: Audio path of a system note in a global voicepack.

getEntrySystemPacenoteFile.desc: Audio path of a system note for an entry (with reuseAudioFrom fallback).

getMetadataFile.desc: Path of the metadata.json of a global voicepack.

getInfo.desc: Reads the voicepack.json of a global voicepack (raw, without validation).

getLanguage.desc: Declared language of a global voicepack.

getStyles.desc: `styles` field of the voicepack.json of a global voicepack.

invalidateCache.desc: Dev/test hook: forgets the global inventory to force a new scan. Preference changes must not call it.

invalidateMissionCache.desc: Forgets the inventory cache of a mission (or of all if missionDir is nil).

makeId.desc: Builds the id of a voicepack: 'global:<dirname>', 'mission:<missionId>:<dirname>' or 'mission:<dirname>'.

parseId.desc: Decomposes an id into {scope, dirname, missionId}.

returns.desc: Parts, nil if the format is invalid.

getVoicepackMRU.desc: Reads the MRU list (setting rallyCodriverVoicepackMRU, CSV or old JSON).

returns.desc: Ids, from most recent to oldest.

getEntryAudioSourceEntries.desc: Global entries whose audio is reused (reuseAudioFrom), read once then cached in entry.audioSourceEntries. Ignores duplicates, itself and invalid dirnames (with a warning).

getEntryAssetDirs.desc: Entry folder followed by those of its audio sources.

getEntryMetadataFile.desc: Path of the entry's metadata.json, or of the first source that has one.

getEntryMetadata.desc: Merges the metadata.json of the entry then of its sources (the first value of a basename wins), with cache in entry._mergedAudioMetadata.

scan.desc: Scans the global voicepacks (excluding `_` folders) and returns the dirname -> entry index, cached.

missionId.desc: Mission id (part of the cache key and of the entries' id).

resolveEntry.desc: Finds the entry of a pick (or an id): the mission index for scope 'mission', the global index otherwise.

resolveDir.desc: First global voicepack matching a language, a persona and a styleLabel (each criterion optional). The order is undefined (pairs).

listInventory.desc: List sorted by label of the available entries: global ones and, if missionDir is given, those of the mission. Filtered by enableAnimalCodrivers and, by default, by the presence of a candidate notebook in the mission.

resolveMissionNotebook.desc: Path of the first notebook declared by the voicepack (vpInfo.notebooks) that exists in the mission.

listMissionNotebookCandidates.desc: Like resolveMissionNotebook but returns all the candidate notebook names (without suffix) that exist in the mission, in order of preference.

ensureSettingsInitialized.desc: If the MRU is empty, puts defaultVoicepackId in it. Does nothing with opts.writeSettings == false.

resolve.desc: Resolves the voicepack to use. Pick of type 'voicepack': exact match in the inventory, otherwise fallback to the preferences ('invalidExactFallback' mode). Other pick or nil: preferences (MRU then detail level).

getCascadeKeys.desc: Compatibility with the old system: language, persona and styleLabel of the global voicepack resolved by the preferences.

resolveEffectiveEntry.desc: Resolves a pick ('auto' is equivalent to 'preferences'; nil = preferences).

buildPickerEntries.desc: Builds the entries of a voicepack selector for a mission: optionally "Resolve from Settings" at the top (includePreferences), then each available voicepack with its label and pick.

resolveLoopVoicepackPick.desc: Turns a loop setting value into a concrete pick for a mission: a 'voicepack' pick is kept; a 'loopVoicepack' pick is looked up by family in the mission's voicepacks.

returns.desc: Concrete pick, nil for preferences or if not found.

addLoopMissionSettingToMRU.desc: Adds to the MRU the voicepack chosen for a loop: directly for a 'voicepack' pick, or the one from the first stage where the family is found.

resolveLoopMissionSettingEntry.desc: Voicepack entry matching a loop setting value.

returns.desc: Entry, nil for preferences or if not found.

buildLoopMissionUserSetting.desc: Builds the user setting (dropdown) for the voicepack of a loop: global voicepacks, plus the mission voicepack families common to all stages of the loop. Selection: current value, otherwise first MRU match, otherwise first item.

returns.desc: {key = 'rallyVoicepackPick', label, type = 'select', values = {{l, v, shortLabel, detail}}, value, currentOption}; nil if there are no entries.

notebookBasenamesForPick.desc: Names of notebooks that can be loaded in the mission for a 'voicepack' type pick.

picksMatch.desc: Compares two picks: same type; 'preferences' (or 'auto') are equal to each other; otherwise same id, or same dirname with compatible scope and missionId.

addToMRU.desc: Puts a voicepack at the head of the MRU (no duplicates, limit 10) and saves the setting. Resolves the entry via resolveEntry if a full entry is not given.

pickFromSettingValue.desc: Converts a setting value into a pick: '', 'preferences', 'auto' give {type='preferences'}; 'loop:<key>' gives a loopVoicepack; a valid id gives a voicepack; anything else falls back to preferences.

buildMissionUserSetting.desc: Builds the user setting (dropdown) for the voicepack of a stage: "Resolve from Settings" then each available voicepack. Selection: current value, otherwise voicepack resolved by preferences, otherwise first item.

returns.desc: Same structure as buildLoopMissionUserSetting; nil if there are no entries.
